meta.scope: Item-side Code Collection rewards and source-backed code/quest/special-claim items only. Exact code strings and live code lists are intentionally excluded.
excluded: Exact code strings and active/expired code-list rows are excluded.
Flame Thrower is excluded because it was found only through the Expired Code Item category and was not in the Code Items table or Code Collection category at check time.
Toy/DLC rows are excluded until row-level item proof is found.

reconciliation.note: The local dataset uses the Code Items table plus Code Collection category-only item pages with row-level proof. Redirected/renamed rows are deduped by canonical item page.
